items.text:
Finds a good scrap total value easily over 60k in one go
Random fire no reason just fire
Instantly takes over half the ship 
New fire extinguisher empties instantly 
Quickly thinking helmet on open all doors vent all air
Working fires going down
Game crashes
3 hours progress lost.

Do you recommend this game?
F*** No!

Edit

Decided to give the game one more go
Find small ship
Start salvaging
Character suddenly flushed and Sick
Goes in ship to get Air
Wait to recover from lack of air
Dead 
Game Over

Seen 1.0 released gave gam another go.
After seeing how little development been between the months I last played and the 1.0 along side the lack of content with lots of copy paste or just missing areas this isnt 1.0 this is closer to 0.5 at best.
items.text_zh:
一次就找到总价值轻松超过 6 万的废料
随机起火，没理由，就是起火
瞬间烧掉半艘船
新灭火器瞬间用空
快速思考，戴上头盔，打开所有门，排空所有空气
火势正在减弱
游戏崩溃
3 小时进度没了。

你推荐这款游戏吗？
去***不推荐！

编辑

决定再给这游戏一次机会
找到一艘小船
开始打捞
角色突然被冲走并生病
进船去获取空气
等待从缺氧中恢复
死了
游戏结束

看到 1.0 发布，又给了游戏一次机会。
在看到我上次游玩那几个月到 1.0 之间开发量有多小，再加上大量复制粘贴或干脆缺失区域的内容匮乏之后，这不是 1.0，这最多更接近 0.5。
